create_ssl_criterion: create a Wav2Vec2SslCriterion instance with a model and loss weight parameters for training
configure_loss_section: configure a Wav2Vec2SslLossSection dataclass with custom diversity and feature penalty weights
run_criterion_forward: run the Wav2Vec2SslCriterion on a SequenceBatch to compute loss and update metrics
prepare_metric_bag: prepare a MetricBag with SSL metrics by calling prepare_metric_bag on the criterion
review_criterion_call: review the Wav2Vec2SslCriterion call method that returns aggregated loss and target count
